gloss: report of lost property; lost item report

definitions.gloss: report of lost property; lost item report
definitions.explanation: An official report or form filed with the police or another authority to notify them that one has lost an item. Filed in the hope that the item may be found and returned.

examples.japanese: {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To file a lost property report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I lost my wallet, so I filed a lost property report with the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}した→紛失する：18835_funshitsusuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}→再発行：18901_saihakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you lose your passport, first file a lost property report, then proceed with the reissue process.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}→紛失：14894_funshitsu⟧ (loss) + {届|とどけ} (notification/report). This is the official term for the form filed at a police station (⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ or ⟦{警察署|けいさつしょ}→警察署：01078_keisatsusho⟧) when something is lost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to file a lost property report
- {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a lost property report (formal)
- {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept a lost property report

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{遺失届|いしつとどけ}→遺失届：24488_ishitsutodoke⟧: lost property report — a more formal synonym
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧: notification, report — the general term for official reports
- {拾得届|しゅうとくとどけ}: found property report — filed when finding someone else's lost item

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a remarkably high rate of returning lost items. Filing a {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ} at a ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ (police box) is a common and effective step, as many lost items are turned in by finders.
